request: Need: organizations need to know whether an authorized trust-policy activation actually executed as declared, whether a required rollback completed and restored the intended policy state, and whether the observed outcome is sufficient to promote, hold, or retire the policy. Intent: define provider-neutral execution reconciliation, recovery verification, and policy promotion records that preserve history and remain human-governed. Context: QIF v0.8.7 records activation, bounded observation, stop decisions, and rollback plans but deliberately does not prove execution, recovery completion, or promotion.
need: Scope only the qif-ledger trust-policy path after v0.8.7: reconcile declared activation and rollback with execution evidence, verify restored state, and record governed promote, hold, retire, or failed-recovery outcomes. Exclude UI, live deployment control, external integrations, cryptographic verification, automatic promotion, automatic authority, and semantic-truth claims.
intent: Success means every executed activation or rollback resolves to immutable execution evidence and expected-versus-observed state; promotion is allowed only after complete bounded observation and successful reconciliation; mismatch, incomplete recovery, or absent authority deterministically blocks promotion and triggers governance; fixtures, npm test, portable build, and AOF verification pass.

clarification_summary: runtime captured first-round clarification answers and can proceed to need validation
options_considered: Advance to planning with the current frame
Ask another clarification round before planning
Stop and request manual intake review
selected_option: Advance to planning with the current frame
decision_summary: Clarification has produced a usable frame and the session can advance to planning.
why_this_option: The request now has enough framed need, intent, and context to plan against.
why_other_options_were_not_selected: Additional clarification is not required for the next planning step, and stopping would discard a usable frame.
policy_tradeoffs_accepted: planning starts once framing is usable, even though future review may still reopen the work
actions: carry the framed need, intent, and context into planning
keep clarification history available for audit and reopen
expected_artifact: planning packet and initial implementation or design plan
expected_outcome: the session can enter Builder-led planning with a stable framed request
completion_criteria: framed request is recorded and a planning-stage decision exists
success_criteria: planning can proceed without reopening clarification immediately
forecast_summary: not required before initial planning begins
uncertainty_notes: planning may still reopen clarification if feasibility or risk gaps emerge
fit_notes: Builder-led planning is now appropriate because the framing gate is complete
change_trigger: clarification answers completed the initial frame
review_trigger: when planning yields a proposal or reopens clarification
review_date_or_condition: at planning completion or on new blocking ambiguity
reopen_conditions: new conflicting signal, weak planning feasibility, or policy conflict
